citation.authors: Ayanlowo O, Olumide YM, Akinkugbe A

cited_by.title: Vitiligo, spread, starting age and treatment options

record.population: 186 patients with vitiligo (2.8% of dermatology clinic attenders) at one hospital in Lagos, Nigeria, 2003 to 2006
record.finding: Vitiligo affected all ages, from 1 to 86 years. The face and limbs were most often affected. Fifteen patients (0.81% as printed in the abstract) had features suggesting an associated autoimmune disease such as type 1 diabetes.
record.note: Describes who attends one clinic, so it cannot give a population age of onset. The abstract's percentage for the 15 patients does not match 15 of 186 and is quoted as printed.
